title: QueryMsg
description: QueryMsg defines the messages that can be queried from the contract to get information.

oneOf.description: Config returns the current contract configuration.
GetData returns the last Solana data that was successfully published (consensus has been reached).
GetAum calculates and returns the current Jupiter AUM value represented in BTC. Returned value is a decimal integer with precision of `DECIMAL_PRECISION` Returns error if data is not valid.
GetRoundInfo returns round info that is needed for oracles to know when to publish data
